emails.subject: Weekly review: Purrline fill rate and PO-E002-0012
emails.body:
Hi Rakesh,

Our weekly review shows your fill rate over the last four weeks at 54%, down from 98% earlier, and on-time-in-full at 57%. PO-E002-0012 is also past its promised date. Ocean Fish Adult is down to 6 days of cover on our side.

Could you send a dated recovery plan and the tracking number for the open PO by Friday 30 Oct? Please also tell us what is behind the shortfall (transport or raw material) so we can plan around it.

Thanks,
Category team

emails.subject: Weekly review: NutriPaws supply and Peanut Butter Biscuits
emails.body:
Hi Meera,

Your recent fill rate is 89%, down from 98% earlier, and on-time-in-full is 69%. The most urgent point is Peanut Butter Biscuits 400 g: it has 0 days of cover and the balance of PO-E003-0010 is not due until 3 Nov.

Can you bring the balance forward, even as a part shipment, and confirm a date by Tuesday 27 Oct?

Thanks,
Category team

emails.subject: Weekly review: Tailwind Play ageing stock and delivery dates
emails.body:
Hi Vikram,

Two points from this week's review. First, 42% of your stock value with us is in the oldest age bucket, mainly the feather wand (150 days of cover) and the printed bandana set (260 days of cover). Can we agree a markdown with funding from your side, or a return of the slowest lines?

Second, on-time-in-full is 78%. Please confirm a firm dispatch date for PO-E004-0007 by Wednesday 28 Oct.

Thanks,
Category team

emails.body:

Category team

emails.subject: Weekly review: Groomwell Deshedding Brush returns and rating
emails.body:
Hi Neha,

The Deshedding Brush has 7.1% returns over four weeks and its rating is down 0.74 stars; customers mostly cite leaking packaging. Could you share what changed in the packaging or the batch, and a corrective plan by Friday 30 Oct?

Separately, Paw Balm sales fell 53% week on week; if you changed anything on your side (price, pack, availability on other platforms) please let us know.

Thanks,
Category team
